premises.text: Small businesses need branding but face expensive crowdsourcing or low-quality DIY
premises.evidence_span: Either pay hundreds and thousands of dollars for online crowdsource services, or if you're like most businesses who can't afford that, you end up doing something on your own and compromise for really low quality branding

premises.text: Over 80 million small businesses want branding they cannot afford
premises.evidence_span: Over 80 million small businesses out there want branding, need branding, but can't really afford it

premises.text: A learning system uses design rules to study a business and generate a custom brand without templates
premises.evidence_span: Taylor is a learning system that turns your computer into a graphic designer

premises.text: Pay-only-when-thrilled $50 purchase delivers logo, business card, letterhead, and brand book
premises.evidence_span: no money exchanges hands until you're completely thrilled with your new design

premises.text: Ongoing service designs offline and online assets as the business grows
premises.evidence_span: It's a service, and it's going to walk with your company and design everything it can possibly need

premises.text: Learning from designed brands yields brand and trend insights for customers
premises.evidence_span: using the thousands of brands it actually designs, it can actually understand brand insights, and trend insights, and give that to you

domains.name: Fifty-dollar satisfied purchase and ongoing assets

value.text: Affordable great branding accessible to every small business
value.evidence_span: put an in-house designer in every business across the world for just 50 bucks
